title: Evidence of capsaicin synthase activity of the Pun1-encoded protein and its role as a determinant of capsaicinoid accumulation in pepper
key_use: Functional evidence that Pun1 participates directly in capsaicin synthesis; VIGS, protein inhibition, and HPLC evidence.
limitations: Does not make exact SHU predictable; cultivar and developmental context remain important.

title: Contrasting modes for loss of pungency between cultivated and wild species of Capsicum
key_use: Documents independent Pun1 loss-of-function alleles and shows Pun2 nonpungency in C. chacoense is non-allelic to Pun1.
limitations: Pun2 was not identified molecularly in this paper.

title: Discovery of novel unfunctional pAMT allele pamt10 causing loss of pungency in sweet bell pepper (Capsicum annuum L.)
key_use: Identifies a nonsense pAMT allele causing nonpungency despite intact Pun1.
limitations: Specific allele and genetic background; does not imply all pAMT variants are null.

title: Positional differences of intronic transposons in pAMT affect the pungency level in chili pepper through altered splicing efficiency
key_use: Shows leaky pAMT alleles can reduce capsaicinoid accumulation to different degrees through altered splicing.
limitations: Quantitative effects are population- and allele-specific.

title: Mutation in the putative ketoacyl-ACP reductase CaKR1 induces loss of pungency in Capsicum
key_use: Maps a recessive nonpungency locus in C. chinense and functionally supports CaKR1 involvement.
limitations: Validated in specific material; broader allele catalog remains incomplete.

title: An R2R3-MYB Transcription Factor Regulates Capsaicinoid Biosynthesis
key_use: CaMYB31 silencing reduced biosynthetic gene expression and capsaicinoid content.
limitations: Regulatory evidence does not define a simple Mendelian phenotype rule or exact heat level.

title: Phytoene synthase 2 can compensate for the absence of PSY1 in the control of color in Capsicum fruit
key_use: Demonstrates PSY2 compensation in a PSY1-deleted and CCS-mutant background; supports multi-gene color modeling.
limitations: Specific genotype and cultivar background; not a universal color lookup.

title: Single-molecule real-time sequencing reveals diverse allelic variations in carotenoid biosynthetic genes in pepper (Capsicum spp.)
key_use: Catalogs allelic variation in PSY1, PSY2, LCYB, BCH, ZEP, and CCS across 94 accessions with pigment analysis.
limitations: Alleles do not fully explain all mature fruit colors; association is not always causal.

title: A mutation in Zeaxanthin epoxidase contributes to orange coloration and alters carotenoid contents in pepper fruit (Capsicum annuum)
source_type: Primary mapping and functional candidate study
key_use: Maps CaOr and identifies a ZEP splicing mutation associated with orange fruit in a defined cross.
limitations: Population-specific; color depends on PSY1/CCS and broader carotenoid background.

title: Chlorophyll breakdown during pepper fruit ripening in the chlorophyll retainer mutation is impaired at the homolog of the senescence-inducible stay-green gene
key_use: CaSGR cosegregates with the cl chlorophyll-retainer mutation and carries a candidate amino-acid substitution.
limitations: Candidate evidence and a specific mutant allele; ripe appearance also depends on carotenoid background.

title: CaGLK2 regulates natural variation of chlorophyll content and fruit color in pepper fruit
key_use: Supports CaGLK2 as underlying pc10 QTL affecting chloroplast compartment size, chlorophyll content, and immature fruit color.
limitations: Quantitative and genetic-background dependent.

title: Network inference analysis identifies an APRR2-like gene linked to pigment accumulation in tomato and pepper fruits
key_use: Supports APRR2-like involvement in plastid and pigment accumulation in pepper fruit.
limitations: Does not by itself establish a universal single-locus inheritance model.

title: Genetic Regulation of Chlorophyll Biosynthesis in Pepper Fruit: Roles of CaAPRR2 and CaGLK2
authors: Study authors as indexed by PubMed
key_use: Reports joint effects of CaAPRR2 and CaGLK2 in a defined F2 population.
limitations: Recent, population-specific candidate-gene evidence; needs independent replication before broad production rules.

title: Identification of CaPs locus involving in purple stripe formation on unripe fruit, reveals allelic variation and alternative splicing of R2R3-MYB transcription factor in pepper
source_type: Primary mapping and functional candidate study
key_use: Maps CaPs and supports CA10g11690/CaAN3 as an allele affecting purple stripe formation.
limitations: Specific allele, tissue pattern, and population; not equivalent to all purple pigmentation.

title: Expression of the Bs2 pepper gene confers resistance to bacterial spot disease in tomato
source_type: Primary gene cloning and functional validation
key_use: Bs2 was cloned and shown to recognize Xanthomonas strains carrying avrBs2.
limitations: Resistance is pathogen-effector dependent and not universal to all bacterial spot strains.

title: Plant pathogen recognition mediated by promoter activation of the pepper Bs3 resistance gene
key_use: Shows Bs3/Bs3-E recognition specificity resides in promoter activation by matching AvrBs3-family effectors.
limitations: Requires pathogen effector identity and host allele; race-specific.

title: Allele-specific CAPS markers based on point mutations in resistance alleles at the pvr1 locus encoding eIF4E in Capsicum
key_use: Defines coding polymorphisms for recessive pvr1 resistance alleles and marker-assisted selection.
limitations: Virus-strain spectrum varies by allele; homozygosity and genetic context matter.

title: Divergent evolution of multiple virus-resistance genes from a progenitor in Capsicum spp.
key_use: Clones Pvr4 and Tsw as related NLR genes on chromosome 10 with distinct virus recognition.
limitations: Resistance remains isolate/pathotype dependent and can be overcome.

title: Development of a sequence characteristic amplified region marker linked to the L4 locus conferring broad spectrum resistance to tobamoviruses in pepper plants
key_use: Provides linked marker evidence for L4-mediated tobamovirus resistance.
limitations: Marker is linked rather than necessarily causal; later pathotypes can overcome L4.

title: Two Amino Acid Substitutions in the Coat Protein of Pepper mild mottle virus Are Responsible for Overcoming the L4 Gene-Mediated Resistance in Capsicum spp.
key_use: Demonstrates a PMMoV pathotype can overcome L4, proving pathotype-specific limits.
limitations: Specific viral isolates and experimental conditions.

title: Fine mapping of Restorer-of-fertility in pepper identified a candidate gene encoding a PPR-containing protein
key_use: Fine maps Rf and identifies CaPPR6 as a strong candidate in a defined CMS/restorer system.
limitations: Candidate rather than universally proven causal allele; CMS systems differ among lines.

title: Linkage analysis between partial restoration and Restorer-of-fertility loci in pepper cytoplasmic male sterility
key_use: Shows CMS restoration involves a major Rf locus, modifier effects, partial restoration, and temperature sensitivity.
limitations: Specific cytoplasm and breeding material; prevents a simplistic single-gene universal rule.

title: Fine mapping of Rf2, a minor Restorer-of-fertility gene for cytoplasmic male sterility in chili pepper G164
key_use: Supports a second dominant restoration locus and identifies Capana06g000193 as a strong candidate.
limitations: Specific restorer line and CMS background; candidate status.

title: Fine mapping of the Chilli veinal mottle virus resistance 4 (cvr4) gene in pepper
authors: Study authors as indexed by PubMed
source_type: Primary fine mapping and gene-silencing study
key_use: Defines cvr4 as a single recessive ChiVMV resistance locus in a specified population and maps it to chromosome 11.
limitations: Gene identity and resistance breadth require additional validation.

title: Spicy genes: mapping quantitative genomic regions and candidate genes for capsaicinoid and capsinoid biosynthesis in pepper
key_use: Integrates 155 reported QTLs into 23 quantitative genomic regions on CM334 v1.6.
limitations: QTL synthesis is not a direct causal-allele catalog and is population/reference-build dependent.

title: Pepper Genomics Database and pan-genome/variome resource
authors: Fei lab / Liu et al. resource
journal: Database resource linked to Nature Communications 2023 work
key_use: Reference genomes, annotations, pan-genome, and variants for 500 core Capsicum accessions.
limitations: Gene IDs and coordinates must be tied to explicit assembly versions.

title: Enabling reusability of plant phenomic datasets with MIAPPE 1.1
key_use: Defines minimum metadata and a data model for reusable plant phenotyping experiments.
limitations: A metadata standard, not a Capsicum genetic model.

title: FAO/Bioversity Multi-Crop Passport Descriptors V.2.1
key_use: International standard for accession passport and provenance data.
limitations: Does not cover detailed genetic assertions or experiments.

title: Descriptors for Capsicum (Capsicum spp.)
key_use: Standardized Capsicum characterization and evaluation terminology.
limitations: Some terminology predates modern molecular genetics and should be mapped rather than copied blindly.

title: BrAPI—an application programming interface for plant breeding applications
key_use: Standard API concepts for germplasm, studies, observations, and marker data exchange.
limitations: Implement only needed endpoints; it does not define scientific validity.
